invariants.rationale: The method expects event to be a valid InputEvent during touch events.
Pointer indices for touch events in LibGDX are typically non-negative.
Button codes for input events should be non-negative.
Coordinates for touch events passed to UI scene2d usually have an origin at (0,0), so x should be non-negative.
Coordinates for touch events passed to UI scene2d usually have an origin at (0,0), so y should be non-negative.
